strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Huh? We rushed over because a colony was attacked, but... it's quiet.
This is our first time in one of these old-nation colonies,
but are all colonies of this type this run-down?
No, not at all. Usually it's much more...
You're right, it's strange... for it to be this quiet...
Yeah... And we can't reach the colony government either...
Something's up. Stay alert, Rain.
We can't contact the colony defense force either.
It looks quiet, but this is an emergency. Everyone, stay on guard.
We rush over here, and the place we came to save is a ghost town?
Something's definitely up.
Could it be an enemy trap...?
Don't tell me... the Einst already...!?
...! What is that!?
These things... could they be!?
Where did they come from...!? And their size...!
From all over the colony... Then the defense force and the townspeople...
Something that size? But the way they move...
...I've seen them before.
That giant flower-like mobile armor Iron Mask was piloting...
It launched those at us a few times...!
Things that were weapons can operate on their own?
Just like Saucer Beasts.
...That's... what that man called his experiment...!
Experiment... these grotesque machines!?
Here they come! Intercepting!
Cecily! Don't get too far ahead!
Wh-What is it this time!?
Domon!! Look at that...
What is it, Rain? What!? Why... why is that thing...!
That thing...? Whaaat!? No way...
That's... the Devil Gundam!
Why is it here!?
Hm... A transmission!?
...Neo Japan... Major Ulube Ishikawa, you say...!?
Major Ulube...! The man who deceived Domon and me!
Domon Kasshu, and everyone of Londo Bell, thank you for coming.
Ulube! What's the meaning of this!? Why is the Devil Gundam here!?
And you...!!
Calm down, Domon.
...The Devil Gundam was originally built in the Neo Japan colony, no?
After you defeated it on Earth, we recovered it to restore its true form...
Doesn't that make perfect sense?
...That's right, Domon.
I helped too, in place of your father, who's serving a cryo-sentence...
Father!?
Those things... those machines... Iron Mask and his men...!
How are you people connected to the Crossbone Vanguard!?
I know nothing...
Domon, Rain... please believe me. I...
Most likely, they learned the Devil Gundam had been brought here...
wouldn't you say? Heh heh...
Ulubeeee...!
In any case, please eliminate the Crossbone Vanguard threat.
Otherwise, the Devil Gundam will be the least of our worries, no?
Ngh...!
Listen up, we're facing two forces at once. Stay sharp!
I wish they'd just wipe each other out.
Those small machines seem built to attack only humans.
And there shouldn't be humans aboard the Devil Gundam or its minions...
Damn! Iron Mask,
you plan to show yourselves only after wiping everyone out!?
Domon, we can't let the Devil Gundam fall into anyone's hands!
Save your anger for later!
I won't forgive this...! We'll scatter these guys,
and defeat the Devil Gundam once again! Let's go!
Got it, Domon!
(Heh heh, the Crossbone Vanguard showing up was a miscalculation, but...
no matter. Londo Bell and all, they can help test
the reborn Devil Gundam...)
Did we get it?
Impossible... Impossible that this Rafflesia... Ooooooooh!
Oh...? You repelled all the Bugs... Impressive.
That's...!
Rafflesia, wasn't it? So you finally show yourself.
As expected of the Federation's trump card... I'll give you that.
I thought the Bugs alone could wipe you out...
but it seems a great harvest truly demands great effort.
As if we'd lose to some knockoff Saucer Beasts!
Iron Mask!
Heh heh... If this test went well,
I intended to drop the Bugs on the Moon and Earth at once...
but it seems there's something I must do first.
Things like this on the Moon... and Earth!?
Screw you! Like we'd let you get away with that!
Iron Mask, was it? I'm in a foul mood right now!
...Prepare yourself!
Quite the brave one, aren't you?
If people could kill with words, I wouldn't need to work so hard.
Shut up!
You think you can do anything to Earth with machines like these!?
And that Devil Gundam... what are you planning to do with it!?
...Don't you understand, Berah? ...A purge.
...A purge?
Space is exhausted.
...And it's not a matter of invading armies or anything of the sort.
The Earth Sphere itself is weary.
That doesn't explain why you built these weapons...!
For the Ronah family's thousand-year dream... to let humanity live forever.
Humanity... forever?
Immortality? ...That's like some fantasy...
Heh, perhaps that phrasing was too difficult for you...
Precisely... it's so humanity can go on living in this universe.
What are you talking about!? You keep spouting nonsense!
Yeah, yeah!
Cosmo Aristocratism... To realize it,
we must thin out the fools who have grown too numerous...!
The world needs a little tidying up.
And for that... you'll use those machines and the Devil Gundam!?
What kind of twisted thinking is that...!
Thinning out people...
No one's conscience need suffer... A fine plan, isn't it?
Random correction by machine... Heh heh...
Just because no conscience suffers... doesn't mean anything goes...!
Don't think humans can judge the worth of other humans!
There are far too many people in this universe.
To govern the new era... the grime of the old must be scrubbed away.
A man who can't do anything without wearing a mask...
has no right to talk about reforming the world!
Berah... You truly are a naughty child.
It's not good to doubt what grown-ups do...!
Nothing but selfish nonsense...!
Ordered to wipe out nine-tenths of humanity, anyone would become this!!
Spoken like a true machine!
Ah... More enemy readings!
The Black Vanguard...
...Of all the troublesome ones...
Lady Berah Ronah...?
I'm not Berah Ronah. Right now, I'm Cecily Fairchild...!
It no longer matters to me.
So you've come, Black Vanguard.
...Iron Mask, what exactly were those just now?
I've never seen them, but they're registered in the data...
Heh heh heh...
Bugs...! Iron Mask!
Yes,
Bugs: unmanned weapons that sense human breath and heat, then strike.
And of course, they've proven fully effective against mobile suits too.
And on top of that, you mean to take in that dubious Devil Gundam as well?
Heh heh... Seems I'm the least of your worries, Domon Kasshu.
...Heh heh... Fwahahahahahaha!
Just you wait, Ulube! You, of all people...!
Don't fall for the provocation! All units, commence attack!
We can't let them use weapons like these!
(What do I do? This battle...
Is there any justice in our Crossbone Vanguard? Blast it!)
Battle Mastery increased by 1.
Yay! Looks like it can't move anymore, Domon!
And I don't see the Death Army anymore either...
Alright, I'll finish it so it can never regenerate! Haaaaah...
What!? Wait! Domon Kasshu!
I'm not listening!
Stop! Please don't! Domon!
Uncle Mikamura! You're just as guilty as Ulube!
I won't believe you!
...Domon...
I want to continue my research so the Devil Gundam
can serve its original purpose of regenerating Earth!
Domon! Destroying it accomplishes nothing!
Your father... Dr. Kasshu would grieve too!
Don't you dare bring up my father's name!
Domon! Stop!
Rain...!?
...I'm sorry... I'm so sorry, Domon...!
Rain...
But! But we have to destroy the Devil Gundam...!
Ngh...! ...Enough talk.
...Tch, a place where this much power gathers... So they sniffed it out...
Th-That means...
Hm!? ...Heh heh, very well.
Conveniently, the Devil Gundam has become easier to seize.
I'll take this chance to deal with them as well...!
Damn, so you've shown up!
The Einst...! Still after the Devil Gundam!?
(This is the moment of truth! You've left an opening, King of Hearts!)
Vanish to parts unknown! My Devil Gundam!
Wha!? Damn it!
Now then... let us start over. Good day to you all.
Ulube!? Are you trying to escape Neo Japan!?
Hahahahahaha! ...Dr. Mikamura, this way.
Surely you won't say you want out now... will you?
Father! Father!
Stay right there! I'm coming for you! Ulube!
Wait! Domon!
The Einst... As expected, they appear where great power gathers...!
Driving them back comes first!
So many of 'em... Fine, screw it!
Let's go out with a bang!
The Neo Japan colony isn't going anywhere! Kasshu!
...I know!! ...I know...!
Domon......
Damn! However many we beat... this is endless!
Hang in there, Roll!
Tch!
I don't have time to waste in a place like this!
Ulube's over there!
Domon, don't get impatient!
Shut up! I...!
You fool! Don't lose your composure over a pinch this trivial!
Whoa! Who's that?
Giving Domon Kasshu a dressing-down like that...
That voice... But why would that man...
But that voice... There's no mistaking it!
Master...! Master!? Why!? You were at Jaburo...!
Hmph, I thought all your battles had made you grow by leaps and bounds...
Yet you let your feelings run ahead of you!
It seems I overestimated you!
Then... Master, you came to help us!?
Domon...
The words you hurled at me at Jaburo... I have not forgotten them.
That humans, too, are a part of nature...
Master Asia......
Looks like he's got no intention of fighting us...
You, who I thought had grown enough to correct your own master's error!
Flustered by something this trivial! How pathetic! I can't bear to watch!
Ngh...
...You are already heir to the School of the Undefeated East, are you not?
Master Asia... Undefeated of the East! ...Master...!
Geez, like disciple, like master. Neither one's honest with himself.
So true, so true.
Indeed... No matter how harsh his words may seem,
all I can sense from that man is concern for Domon.
Yes...
Martial artists are clumsy folk who can only speak through their fists...
Do martial artists have... some kind of telepathy?
Who knows? Probably just birds of a feather, right?
I get how they both feel!
Domon's made up with his master now... I'm so glad...
(Something only martial artists understand... And I......)
Now, Domon! You have no time to dawdle!
What must you do now!?
Defeat the enemies after the Devil Gundam,
and restore peace to the Neo Japan colony!
Exactly! Listen well, do not be fazed by the enemy's numbers.
Fear not the enemy... fear only that your fighting spirit may break!
Let's go! You foolish pupil!
Yes! ...Master!
In the end, you could never take off your mask...
Cecily...
It's all right, Seabook... What the Ronah family was trying to do...
It wasn't wrong... It's just...
That's enough, it's okay, Cecily...
Seabook...
(This too... is fate.
With Iron Mask dead, must our battle start over from scratch?)
Is it over...?
Phew, that was rough.
I hate those tiny saucers.
Master...! Master!? Why!? You were at Jaburo...!
Hmph, I thought all your battles had made you grow by leaps and bounds...
Yet you let your feelings run ahead of you!
It seems I overestimated you!
Then... Master, you came to help us!?
Domon...
The words you hurled at me at Jaburo... I have not forgotten them.
That humans, too, are a part of nature...
Master Asia......
Looks like he's got no intention of fighting us...
...You are already heir to the School of the Undefeated East, are you not?
Master Asia... Undefeated of the East! ...Master...!
Geez, like disciple, like master. Neither one's honest with himself.
So true, so true.
Indeed... No matter how harsh his words may seem,
all I can sense from that man is concern for Domon.
Yes...
Martial artists are clumsy folk who can only speak through their fists...
Do martial artists have... some kind of telepathy?
Who knows? Probably just birds of a feather, right?
I get how they both feel!
Domon's made up with his master now... I'm so glad...
(Something only martial artists understand... And I......)
We beat that big flower freak too. Bet they've learned their lesson, huh?
But... after this defeat, that army's plan to thin out humanity...
Will they really give up on it...?
Right... We didn't strike at the source.
...I think... it'll probably be all right.
Why, Cecily?
Iron Mask... was in too much of a hurry.
He augmented himself into a mass of ego, blind to all but his goal...
...That too... may have been one way of doing things, but...
Order that can only be achieved that way... means nothing...
...Rafflesia, a flower blooming in space... huh.
And that flower merely scattered, wretchedly.
This is no time to get sentimental! Ulube...!
Hold on, Kasshu. ...We're on a mission.
What!? You're telling me to back down here...!?
Domon!
Rain...?
......Captain Bright says he'll contact the Neo Japan government...
to have Ulube... and my father... arrested.
Domon... try to understand how Rain feels too.
If you went and punched her father...
......All right, Allenby.
I'm sorry... Domon...
